$comment: Buckets are the catalog's one source of truth for two things at once: what a skill is for, and whether it ships. A directory under skills/ IS a bucket; everything inside a bucket is a skill. Only promoted buckets may appear in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json, and only promoted buckets appear on clickai.dev — so parking a half-built skill in in-progress/ removes it from both without deleting it. scripts/check_router_freshness.py enforces this.
